correctness.rationale: Complete proof: long-gap local-move bijection for n≥5, exact \(n/k\) anchoring of circular gap words, coefficient extraction, four-residue slack classification, unique oriented five-site-edge count \(nF_{n-3}\), and classical Perrin identification. The self-contained verifier enumerates 39,585 actual independent sets on sizes 5..20 and corroborates each degree and edge; n up to 75 gives additional formula checks. Exhaustion on finite rings is only corroboration, not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The inspected at-most-two and one-hop models are not the exact-two-only model. The closest published maximal-independent-set degree law is restricted to all-short-gap configurations, and its nonzero-degree slides vanish under our rule. The novel claim is the full exact-two-hop degree polynomial, sharp extremal counts, and edge enumeration. Perrin frozen counts are credited as known; priority is qualified by unindexed literature risk.

value.rationale: A strict two-site move is a natural discrete exclusion-process and combinatorial reconfiguration primitive, distinct from adjacency sliding and bounded-at-most hops. The complete exact spectrum gives all statewise mobility classes for every particle occupancy, not a cherry-picked small invariant, while the sharp four-residue maximizer counts and total edges quantify availability of moves. It is a motivated all-parameter structural classification; no reachability or downstream code bound is claimed.
